subject: Generated files never get hand-merged: on conflict take the shared version and regenerate
body: packages/shared/ui-copy.defaults.json, packages/shared/openapi.json, packages/shared/src/gen/**, apps/api/requirements.txt: during a rebase conflict, git checkout --theirs <file> (the shared side when rebasing is 'ours' in git terms — use 'git checkout --ours' inside a rebase), then run the generator (pnpm gen:contracts / the ui-copy defaults script / pnpm gen:requirements), git add, rebase --continue. seg12: do this for ui-copy.defaults.json now.
